pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/index.tsx:103 The view renders authored English copy directly in JSX, bypassing the catalog required for user-facing strings.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/index.tsx:103 The heading is literal display text rather than a typed catalog reference.
src/lib/localization/qa-engine.ts:282 Readiness requires some entries and no findings, but never requires an entry for every source string; a partially translated locale can pass.

src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/TranslationsTab.tsx:67 This control filters translation records for review; it does not select a reader's runtime language or deliver a shipped locale bundle.

src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/index.tsx:142 The message builds English plurals by appending 's' and inserts a conditional prose fragment instead of using complete catalog messages and locale plural rules.

src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/MiniStat.tsx:7 Stat labels truncate without a tooltip, expansion control, or other full-value recourse, violating the layout-tolerance requirement.

src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/TranslationCard.tsx:33 Translated previews use the same typography across scripts; the inherited font is Latin-subset Geist, and searches found no script-based font or metric rules.
src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/HazardCard.tsx:47 The badge renders a known severity token directly instead of resolving a category-specific catalog label.
